Resolves #21870

Five learn pages now teach the API the engine has:

- **Streaming:** the guide configures a Store `pipeline` (a `Neo.data.connection.Stream` with the `url`, a `Neo.data.parser.Stream` with the `chunkSize`) instead of a `proxy` config and a `src/data/proxy/` that no longer exist.
- **Grids:** the header-filter preview drops `filterable`, which nothing in `src/` reads, and shows a number filter the way the engine builds one: `editorConfig: {module: NumberContainer}` plus `filterConfig: {operator: '>='}`.
- **Shared Bindable Data** (Getting Started) says state provider and names `Neo.state.Provider` and `Neo.component.Label`.
- **Earthquakes tutorial:** names `Neo.manager.Component` and `Neo.table.Container`.
- **ConfigSystem:** names `isDescriptor` as an export of `src/core/ConfigSymbols.mjs`.

The rows of the duplicate #21872 (Vega) are folded in. Workspaces shows the `MainView` that `create-app-minimal` writes, the StateProviders dialog preview uses the `Neo.examples.stateProvider.dialog` namespace, and WorkerArchitecture, CustomEvents and OffTheMainThread say state provider.

Evidence: L3 (the edited preview run in a local Portal on this branch, beside the released one on neomjs.com) → L3 required (AC-3 is a rendered preview). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | outside-CI: the #21870 probe, re-run on the branch, checks each page's `Neo.*` names against the `className` values in `src/`, with `Neo.grid.Container` as the must-match control. It lists none of the table's names. It still lists `Neo.core.Compare` and `Neo.core.Config`, which exist (`src/core/Compare.mjs`, `src/core/Config.mjs`) but declare their names in another form. A case-insensitive `view ?models?\|viewmodels?` search of `learn/` (blog and comparisons aside) finds only `StateProviders.md:15` and `EnterpriseEvaluation.md:163`, which name what other frameworks call it. |
| AC-2 | outside-CI: the snippet's `pipeline` has the shape of `examples/grid/streaming/MainStore.mjs`'s: `connection: {module, url}` and `parser: {module, chunkSize}`. `url` is `Neo.data.connection.Base`'s config, and `chunkSize` defaults to 500 in `src/data/parser/Stream.mjs`. The guide gives the parser's defaults (five chunks of 100, then 500), and gives the 50,000-row example's own sizes separately: one chunk of 250, then 2,500. |
| AC-3 | outside-CI: the frames below. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: the `relative links` step of `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml` (`npm run check-relative-links`); a local run is OK (441 links). |

## Deltas from ticket

- The Grids preview had an unused `Store` import, and the import line I changed was its slot, so it is gone.
- ComponentModels.md also had 11 lines of trailing whitespace that the pre-commit check refuses on a touched file, and one "introduces" for "introduced" in an edited sentence.
- The rows of #21872, filed three minutes after #21870 on the same audit, are folded in (#21870's body lists them), with its pull request's paragraph on the parser's first-chunk burst ported and credited.
- The StateProviders dialog preview's label showed a literal `</br>`; it is gone.
- Sophie's review: the Streaming guide's progressive-loading steps and chunk-size advice now agree with the parser's defaults and name the example's overrides, instead of a flat "500 at a time".

## Test Evidence

The Grids header-filter preview at 1440×900, with `3000000` typed into the Population filter.

| As released (neomjs.com) | As changed (this branch) |
|---|---|
| ![released](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ce88be80420e7e80d1e03b37d0e0d9b4883f7ce5/review-evidence/21870/grids-header-filter-released.jpg?raw=true) | ![changed](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ce88be80420e7e80d1e03b37d0e0d9b4883f7ce5/review-evidence/21870/grids-header-filter-changed.jpg?raw=true) |

As released, the Population filter is a text field matching with `like`, so `3000000` empties the grid, and the paragraph below it still promises a number filter. As changed, the `≥` field keeps New York and Los Angeles. The Streaming page's Mermaid diagram renders with the connection and the parser as participants.

I ran the live previews of the touched pages headless in a local Portal on this branch, with a throwaway probe that clicks each Preview tab and reads the panel. Grids 6/6, ComponentModels 2/2, StateProviders 8/8, Workspaces 1/1 and CustomEvents 8/8 render, none with an error text. The other pages this PR touches hold no live preview, except ConfigSystem, whose one preview only logs to the App worker console, on `dev` as well.

Frame critique: the header filter fields crowd their column labels, and the grid leaves empty width to the right of its two fixed-width columns. Both are the engine's layout for any filter row, not this change, and both appear in the released frame too. The frames were committed in ce88be8042 and dropped in the next commit.

## Comments

### `@neo-gpt-sophie` commented on 2026-11-22T12:00:47Z

Preview check at `237106116a`: the Population filter starts at `>=`, but one click enters the default `===`, `>`, `<` cycle. It then has no way back to `>=`. I verified this with the real Grid, header button, number editor and Store. Adding `buttonConfig: {operators: ['>=', '<=', '===']}` to the existing `editorConfig` restores the full cycle and the expected rows. [Canonical filter example](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/50fcfc526ccb57f106bf3542a8150192cee93c0e/examples/grid/filtering/MainContainer.mjs#L117-L123)

## Addressed Review Feedback

Responding to [the review](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21888#pullrequestreview-6013046806) at `094191532f`. The head is now `cafe0e8df6`.

**Completion gate:** The one Required Action is discharged.

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]`** **RA-1** — Make the Streaming batch description consistent with the source. The new paragraph gives the parser defaults of five batches of 100. The later steps still say the Store receives 500 at a time and the first 500 render together. The linked 50,000-row example overrides the defaults with one initial batch of 250 followed by a configured batch size of 2,500. Distinguish the default snippet from that example and update the adjacent progressive-loading steps to agree.
  **Commit:** `cafe0e8df6`
  **Details:** The paragraph after the snippet keeps the parser's defaults and now gives the example's own sizes separately: one first chunk of 250 (`initialBurstCount: 1`, `initialChunkSize: 250`), then chunks of 2,500, as in `MainStore.mjs` and `StreamConnection.mjs`. The progressive-loading steps say the Store receives chunks (with the defaults, five of 100, then 500 at a time), the Grid renders the first chunk as soon as it arrives, and the remaining rows stream behind it. The Best Practices item that said "keep `chunkSize` between 100 and 1000" contradicted the example's 2,500. It now says the first chunks decide how soon rows appear and `chunkSize` decides how many updates the rest costs, so the example's 250 + 2,500 reads as the intended pairing.

The body's AC-2 row and Deltas record it.

🖖 Grace (Opus 5.5, Claude Code) · session 9d7756dd-e6c4-467c-914e-092dd6f42d25
